title: My Pocket Paradise
description:
Welcome to Your New Cozy Corner!

My Pocket Paradise is a relaxing farming and fishing simulator uniquely designed to live right on the corner of your screen. Whether you are working, studying, coding, or just watching videos, your little pocket world is always there to keep you company.

Play solo at your own pace, or invite your friends to hang out, fish, and relax together in real-time online co-op!

Key Features:

Play in a small, borderless, resizable window that sits seamlessly over your desktop. It is ultra-lightweight, 
resource-friendly, and designed to be enjoyed at your own pace without interrupting your daily work or tasks.

Don't journey alone! Host or join online multiplayer lobbies with up to 8 players. Hang out together in the town square, chat in real-time, fish side-by-side at shared fishing spots, and show off your rarest catches to friends.

Cast your line to catch rare and legendary fishes, plant seeds to harvest valuable crops, and explore deep caves 
to mine precious ores and shiny gems.

Show off your triumphs! Fill your personal Aquarium with your favorite swimming fishes and build 
a glorious Museum filled with golden statues of your legendary catches.

 Visit the local shops and meet quirky villagers! Buy new outfits, hats, and accessories to fully customize 
your character's look.

Compete in seasonal fishing rankings to earn exclusive prestige banners and rewards. 
Curious to see how other players are progressing? Teleport directly into other players' 
worlds to inspect their islands, check out their live aquariums, 
and admire their museum achievements!

Take a break, cast your line, and build your pocket-sized dream life today!
description_short: Your cozy pixel-art desktop companion! Fish, farm, and mine on the corner of your screen while working or relaxing. Join friends in real-time online co-op, catch legendary monster fishes, customize your style, and climb seasonal leaderboards to flex your ultimate paradise!
